LightningComponentBundle.description: Shop-by-product section: product category cards with modern featured icons and link CTAs, styled with the Veeam design tokens.

property.name: intro
property.label: Intro text
property.default: Go straight to pricing and editions for the products you already know or use.

property.name: categoriesJson
property.label: Categories (JSON, optional)
property.description: Optional JSON array to override the four default products. Each item: {id, count, title, description, cta, url, icon}. icon = shield-tick | grid-01 | download-cloud-02 | safe. Leave blank to use the defaults.
